description:
Urban sources of air pollution, acute and chronic health effects of pollution taught through case studies; environmental quality standards and compliance criteria in BC and Canada; air quality modelling for prediction, introduction to software; integrated waste management and design, reduce, reuse, recycle, resource recovery and utilization, composting, fundamentals of waste degradation and disposal, geo-environmental aspects of landfill design, leachate and gas management at landfills.

* Indicates a 3-hour laboratory taken by students on alternate weeks.
preAndCorequisites:
• Complete all of:
    • CIVE310 - Introduction to Environmental Engineering (1.5)
title: Solid Waste and Air Pollution
